source_title: 'My body hurts, my soul hurts': Christa Pike after failed execution in US
source_excerpt: Tennessee death row inmate Christa Pike has said she remains in constant physical and psychological pain after surviving a botched lethal injection on September 30. In her first public statement since the failed execution, the 50-year-old described her injuries, isolation in a prison hospital and uncertainty about her future.In a statement dictated to her lawyers and released on Friday, the 50-year-old said she had been struggling with pain and speech difficulties since the execution attempt.âThere hasnât been a moment since that night when I havenât been in pain. My body hurts. My arms hurt. My hands hurt. My throat hurts. I still struggle to speak,â Pike said.âAnd the pain isnât just physical. There is pain in my mind and in my soul.âPike, who is being held at the Debra K Johnson Rehabilitation Center in Tennessee, said she had prepared herself to die peacefully but instead regained consciousness alone in a hospital bed.âI donât know why I survived that night. I donât know what comes next,â she said, adding that she was âsearching for meaning in what happened to meâ.She also expressed concern for the family of her victim, 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer.âI continue to think about my victimâs family,â Pike said, referring to the âterrible pain and loss they have enduredâ.Pike thanked the first responders and medical staff who treated her, saying support from people around the world had given her strength.âTo know that so many people care about me, that they see me as a human being whose life matters, is something I cannot fully put into words,â she said.Pike survived two doses of pentobarbital during her scheduled execution at Riverbend Maximum Security Institution on September 30. Her lawyers said the injections may not have entered her bloodstream correctly, instead pooling in her arms and causing severe injuries, including burns and blistering.According to court documents, the execution team struggled to establish functioning intravenous lines. Pike reportedly complained of burning pain before losing consciousness and being transferred to a Nashville hospital in critical condition. She was discharged on October 10.Her lawyers have also asked a federal judge to end her isolation in the prison infirmary, arguing that it violates a 2024 agreement allowing her social contact with other women prisoners. They said the isolation had caused significant psychological harm.Meanwhile, a Tennessee judge has ordered officials to preserve evidence relating to the failed execution. Her lawyers have alleged that the incident violated the constitutional prohibition on cruel and unusual punishment.Governor Bill Lee has appointed a former US attorney to review the incident and suspended the state's remaining executions for the year. The move follows another problematic execution attempt in May.Lee rejected Pike's clemency appeal before the execution attempt. Asked about her sentence this week, he said, âI suspect her sentence will be the same as before unless determined otherwise by the courts.âPike remains on death row. ## घटना का विवरण
30 सितंबर को टेनेसी की रिवरबेंड मैक्सिमम सिक्योरिटी इंस्टीट्यूशन में डेथ रो कैदी क्रिस्टा पाइक को जानलेवा इंजेक्शन देने की प्रक्रिया विफल रही। इसके बाद, 50 वर्षीय पाइक को गंभीर हालत में नैशविले के एक अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया गया था, जहां से उन्हें 10 अक्टूबर को छुट्टी मिली।

## पाइक का बयान
शुक्रवार को अपने वकीलों के माध्यम से जारी एक बयान में, पाइक ने निरंतर शारीरिक और मानसिक पीड़ा का वर्णन किया। उनके बयान के मुख्य बिंदु:
* **शारीरिक पीड़ा:** पाइक ने अपने शरीर, हाथों और गले में लगातार दर्द की शिकायत की है और बताया है कि उन्हें बोलने में कठिनाई हो रही है।
* **मानसिक स्थिति:** उन्होंने अपनी मानसिक और आत्मिक पीड़ा के बारे में बात की और कहा कि उन्हें समझ नहीं आ रहा कि वे उस रात जीवित कैसे बचीं।
* **पीड़िता के परिवार के प्रति संवेदना:** पाइक ने अपनी पीड़िता, 19 वर्षीय कोलीन स्लेमर के परिवार के प्रति चिंता व्यक्त की।

## कानूनी और प्रशासनिक कदम
* **जांच:** टेनेसी के गवर्नर बिल ली ने वर्ष के शेष सभी निष्पादनों को निलंबित कर दिया है और मामले की समीक्षा के लिए एक पूर्व अमेरिकी अटॉर्नी को नियुक्त किया है।
* **साक्ष्य संरक्षण:** एक राज्य न्यायाधीश ने अधिकारियों को घटना से संबंधित सभी साक्ष्यों को सुरक्षित रखने का आदेश दिया है।
* **जेल की स्थिति:** पाइक के वकीलों ने जेल के अस्पताल में उन्हें अलग रखे जाने का विरोध किया है, जिसे वे 2024 के एक समझौते का उल्लंघन मानते हैं।
* **वर्तमान स्थिति:** पाइक अभी भी डेथ रो पर हैं। उनके वकील उनकी सजा को आजीवन कारावास में बदलने की मांग कर रहे हैं, हालांकि गवर्नर ली ने कहा है कि जब तक अदालतें कोई निर्णय नहीं लेतीं, उनकी सजा वही रहेगी।

इंट्रावेनस लाइनों की विफलता और उसके परिणामस्वरूप हुई चोटों की जानकारी अदालत के दस्तावेजों और कानूनी सलाहकारों के दावों पर आधारित है।
hi_title: टेनेसी में निष्पादन विफल होने के बाद क्रिस्टा पाइक का पहला बयान
hi_meta: टेनेसी में 30 सितंबर को निष्पादन विफल होने के बाद डेथ रो कैदी क्रिस्टा पाइक ने अपनी शारीरिक और मानसिक पीड़ा के बारे में सार्वजनिक बयान दिया है।
en_body:
## Overview of the Incident
On September 30, a scheduled lethal injection of death row inmate Christa Pike at the Riverbend Maximum Security Institution in Tennessee failed. Following the incident, the 50-year-old was transferred to a Nashville hospital in critical condition, where she remained until her discharge on October 10. 

## Pike’s Statement
In her first public comments, dictated to her lawyers and released on Friday, Pike described constant physical and mental suffering. Key points from her statement include:
* **Physical Distress:** Pike reported persistent pain in her body, arms, hands, and throat, noting that she continues to face difficulties with speech.
* **Psychological Impact:** She described feeling profound mental and spiritual pain, expressing uncertainty about her future and the reasons for her survival.
* **Victim Remembrance:** Pike expressed concern for the family of her victim, 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer, acknowledging the loss they have endured.

## Legal and Administrative Actions
* **Investigation:** Tennessee Governor Bill Lee has suspended all remaining executions for the year and appointed a former US attorney to review the botched procedure.
* **Evidence Preservation:** A state judge has ordered authorities to preserve all evidence related to the incident.
* **Conditions of Confinement:** Pike’s legal team is challenging her ongoing isolation in the prison infirmary, arguing that it breaches a 2024 agreement regarding her social access.
* **Current Status:** While her lawyers are seeking to have her sentence commuted to life imprisonment, Governor Lee indicated that her death sentence remains in place unless otherwise determined by the courts.

Information regarding the technical failure of the intravenous lines and the resulting injuries, such as blistering, is derived from court filings and legal counsel assertions.
